subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers require a live current-main WSL2 or Docker reproduction of the secondary-agent global-scope heartbeat route before queueing a fix PR?
rationale: Source inspection and reporter evidence are credible, but the affected behavior crosses the compatibility-sensitive global session contract documented for heartbeats.

options.title: Run live repro first
options.body: Confirm the reported `global` plus `per-channel-peer` case on current main before deciding the exact repair boundary.

options.title: Queue source-level repair now
options.body: Accept the source-level evidence and ask for a focused fix plus tests without waiting for live WSL2/Docker proof.

options.title: Treat global scope as intended
options.body: Close or reframe the issue only if maintainers confirm that global heartbeat sessions intentionally override per-agent session isolation.

recommendation.title: Run live repro first
recommendation.body: Confirm the reported `global` plus `per-channel-peer` case on current main before deciding the exact repair boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and recent gateway/heartbeat routing history point to this person as the strongest owner for deciding the proof bar and global-scope contract.
